item.title: Tragic Loss In UP: Infant dies after accidentally being crushed between sleeping parents
item.description: A 26-day-old baby was found lifeless in a UP home after allegedly being accidentally suffocated while sleeping between his parents. As doctors warn of the dangers of co-sleeping, another child death grips the state. What went wrong that night?

item.title: UP extends SIR deadline to December 25 for voter verification; Details inside
item.description: The voter revision exercise in Uttar Pradesh has been granted an extra 14 days as authorities seek error free verification, complete mapping based checks and prepare a clean, updated roll ahead of the 2026 final list release.

item.title: Why these Green vegetables are a must have this winter for strong immunity
item.description: As temperatures drop across the country, nutrition experts highlight the importance of including seasonal green vegetables in daily meals. Winter greens provide vital nutrients, strengthen immunity and support better energy levels throughout the season.

item.title: Ranveer Singh’s Action Thriller Dhurandhar Dominates Box Office but Not Yet a Hit
item.description: Ranveer Singh’s action thriller 'Dhurandhar' has wowed audiences and earned over ₹224 crore worldwide. Despite strong box office performance, it hasn’t become a hit yet, but the upcoming sequel promises more excitement.

item.title: Big Traffic Reform in Maharashtra: Only cops with bodycams to issue challans in state; Details Inside
item.description: Maharashtra is set to transform traffic enforcement: soon, only police wearing body cameras can issue challans. But that’s not all the government is also fast-tracking flood-damaged road repairs and planning smarter infrastructure across the state.

item.title: Kenduadih Gas Emission: CIL Chairman conducts high-level situation review; Details inside
item.description: Following the December 3 gas emission incident in Kenduadih, coal ministry and BCCL leaders review relief and rescue measures, emphasizing immediate evacuation and long-term rehabilitation to protect residents from escalating hazards.

item.title: SIR 2.0: Is your name on the voter list? A step-by-step guide
item.description: SIR 2.0 is underway across 12 states, letting voters check if their details are uploaded on the ECI portal. Are you on the electoral roll, or could your name be missing? Here’s a simple step-by-step guide to find out.

item.title: Pakistan shuts Afghan refugee camps, sparks mass repatriation
item.description: Pakistan’s federal government has abruptly closed three decades-old Afghan refugee camps in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, cutting essential services and forcibly sending tens of thousands across the border amid rising tensions with Taliban-ruled Afghanistan.

item.title: Massive earthquake jolts Japan days after 7.5 tremors; Full story here
item.description: Japan has been rattled by a third consecutive earthquake in just days, following Monday’s massive 7.6 tremor. While no tsunami warning has been issued, experts warn the seismic risk is rising could an even bigger quake be on the horizon?

item.title: Judges vs Lawyers: SCBA Triumphs Over CJI-XI in a Thrilling 22-Over Showdown
item.description: A thrilling 22-over match at Arun Jaitley Stadium saw judges face lawyers in a rare and exciting contest. SCBA chased 139 runs to defeat CJI-XI. Chief Justice Suryakant praised the enthusiasm among judges, lawyers, and players.
